_comment: options.c handler_autopickup_exception() add_autopickup_exception(): two patterns that regcomp rejects ('(' unmatched, '<*arrow' with a leading '*') report their config errors through cfgfiles.c config_error_add() pline()/wait_synch(), then a valid '<arrow' is added and listed. macOS regerror() reports them as 'parentheses not balanced' and 'repetition-operator operand invalid'; glibc's text differs. Recorded on macOS, the judge's host, by .github/workflows/macos-recorder.yml (run 44628090866), because regcomp() and regerror() differ between macOS and glibc (docs/testing.md, "The regex difference").
